g.title: work_loop
g.text: Work loop: act until the predicate holds; leave the record; wake

g.title: wake
g.text: print verdict, action or party, reason and predicate
(missing refs, pending transition or recovery: one line, exit 3)

g.title: waiting
g.text: Waiting: print the escalation's five fields verbatim;
the agent adds nothing to the work, asks the developer in prose
and records their answer with cairn answer
(developer: absent and a floor or veto escalation: same print, exit 4)

g.title: reply
g.text: a reply record names the escalation

g.title: stop
g.text: Done: a done record exists and nothing waits;

g.title: act
g.text: Do the named action until its predicate holds
(the table below is in precedence order)

g.title: answer
g.text: The agent asks the developer in conversation and records the words:
signed when a key exists, attested otherwise

g.title: cannot
g.text: Cannot act, or cycle bound reached?

g.title: measure
g.text: (five Score levels, composite, veto, suggested: advice, not a route)

g.title: actions
g.text: hand-written input parses; no unrelated byte changed
intent has a terminal domain or abort record; every store matches its result
local action lease is gone; action finished or was abandoned
each durable breach is developer-kept or restored to its allowed base; later declaration never clears it
fix snapshot changes no protected contract; requirement has a current pass
action lease covers the path, or it is clean
path is clean, or the action lease covers it
mechanism definition names REQ; no prior undeclared delta was legalized
current receipt matches input snapshot, definition, text and declared execution identity
current pass plus review metadata bound to current definition and frozen text, with fail receipt
after three failing attempts, an escalation exists before a fourth
review metadata binds definition and text to a fail receipt; product inputs unchanged
outside record or escalation names it
current workspace snapshot; every fixed question answered for each target
isolated projection; current brief and report; all question and interface attempts present
resolution or developer dispute names N on its exact source record
current acceptance examines cumulative delta and every submitted resolution; it may add findings
realized line names base and result snapshots; actual delta passes protected-category check
Done rule holds; cairn done writes the final record
one backlog item, decision, roadmap move and successor start are one transaction

g.title: escalate
g.text: cycle guard: fourth same-target or 28th admin transition,

g.title: trace
g.text: branch commit, typed snapshot or canonical log record
